name: s81sl_lepnh-s81sl_lepnh-COMMIT
purpose: S81-LEPV: host-less end-slice link-port leaf (HOST_EN 0, s_0S / s_0N / s_7S) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_lep_nh u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_mem1r1w.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_slice_lep.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepnh/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepnh/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepnh --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_lep_nh --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-LEPV (owner 10-18 "remove ties where cheap"): HOST_EN 0 variant of the end-slice link-port leaf s81sl_lep for the three endpoints without the host plane (s_0S / s_0N via dsdv_slice_lepw, s_7S via dsdv_slice_lepe_nh). Same macros, placement, outline and E / W / S faces as s81sl_lep; NO N face: t_host / t_kd / f_host / f_lf / f_ks and l0_st / l1_st are not ports, the THOST / TKD pending registers, host pin flops and f_host / f_ks / f_lf registers are generated out; a HOST / KS frame arriving here is a protocol fault. Replaces 3 x 131 b of tied die pads.
